disassembly_hash_format: UTF-8 text with LF line endings
behavior: Init reads heal into m_Percent(+0x8c); attack_count defaults to1 if missing. At0x1490d99 registers callback36280 in ActionsOnDamageDealt(+0x70), using method usage GOT+0x4a494.

Callback0x14912be obtains source from argument at ebp+0x14, computes incomingNormalizedHit*m_Percent/100 at0x1491302..0x149131a, then invokes source.HealDamage(amount, source) through ICombatant slot112.
Callback calls HealCurrentTurn(target=source, ignoreZero=true, all remaining flags/source=false/null). There is no source-health, participation, positive-damage or random predicate in this callback.

AttackSkillTemplate iterator invokes ActionsOnDamageDealt at0xeb962c for each hit with normalized damage from DealDamageFromCurrentTurn, including ordinary overkill. It is not total HP removed from all hits/targets.
HealCurrentTurn normalizes the accumulated queue before and after the currently implemented healing-reduction trigger pass and caps HP. The runtime retains bird knockout flags when HP refills.
The former pig-only attack-end heal and alive predicate are removed; the same per-hit callback routes source by faction.
limitations: Full native fractional HP and full damage/retaliation/heal/perk/trigger order remain unfinished.
Runtime bird knockout flags are retained on healing; complete native death/participation/despawn/revival state transitions, particularly for pigs, still require recovery.
Current shield/retaliation and presentation sequencing remain partial reconstructions; original life-steal visual effects and timing are not claimed complete.
The callback supports both factions, but no new bird skill or class is invented or added to the original catalog.
